# FILTERS exercise bank - index

490 multiple-choice exercises from the interactive online edition of
*Introduction to Digital Filters with Audio Applications* (https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/filters/), one file per chapter, in book order.
Each exercise names the book page it belongs to, its difficulty (1-3), and concept
tags. Answers and explanations are included: they are for the tutor, never to be
shown before the learner has committed to an answer.
